title: Replication package - The invisible majority: linking a national researcher registry to OpenAlex reveals Peru's uncertified artificial intelligence workforce
description: Data and code to replicate the linkage of Peru's RENACYT researcher registry (11,757 researchers, May 2024) with OpenAlex AI and Computer Vision works (2015-2026), identifying 856 certified AI researchers. Seven-stage pipeline: harvest, cleaning, population extraction, three-tier name linkage, analysis, figures, and false-negative inspection.
